[D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
|-- Immutable captured state
|   |-- Source identity
|   |   |-- format: messages-v1
|   |   |-- agentType
|   |   `-- sourceSessionId: original coding trajectory
|   |-- Selected range on one branch
|   |   |-- fromEntryId
|   |   `-- throughEntryId
|   |-- Ordered messages
|   |   |-- User messages
|   |   |-- Assistant messages and tool calls
|   |   `-- Tool results linked by tool-call ID
|   `-- contentHash: exact snapshot identity
|-- Construction and adapter logic
|   |-- static fromTrajectory(selection): AgentContext
|   |   |-- Parse source records; resolve branch and range
|   |   |-- Validate user/assistant/toolResult message variants
|   |   `-- Reject incomplete tool groups or ambiguous slices
|   `-- static fromSnapshot(snapshot): AgentContext
|       `-- Validate data and verify content hash
|-- Conversion
|   `-- toPiMessages(): PiHistoryMessage[]
|       |-- Preserve roles, content blocks and tool-call IDs
|       `-- Return fresh Pi-compatible history objects
|-- Serialization
|   `-- toSnapshot(): AgentContextSnapshot
|       |-- version: 1
|       |-- source and range
|       |-- messages
|       `-- contentHash
`-- Boundaries
    |-- Owns parsing, slicing, validation and conversion
    |-- Caller supplies trajectory; no file or network I/O
    |-- Snapshot survives JSON transport and structuredClone
    `-- Source session stays separate from canvas and new Pi session
